name: Faint
description: The viewer faints: the first clip splits into two swaying copies of itself and blurs while the edges of the view darken and close in, in two heartbeat throbs, down to a last pinpoint of light; the second clip comes back blurred and doubled through a narrow tunnel, which widens again in throbs as the two copies drift together and lock. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: separation
params.description: How far apart the two copies drift at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: blur
params.description: How out of focus the view gets
